title: 📊️ Repository metrics
description: 📊️ The wire shapes of the `📊️metrics` domain: the recorded `git log --numstat` transcript fixtures, the per-commit deltas the parser produces, the `LocReport` the aggregation composes, the time buckets and the benchmark timing model. Both implementations (`semio-framework-repo-metrics` and `github.com/usalu/semio/repo/metrics`) serialise exactly these shapes.

LinePair.description: 🟨️ Added and removed line counts of one change.

Bucket.description: 🏷️ A `loc` row label: one of the code languages, or the `Markup` / `Data` / `Code` / `Total` aggregates.

FileDelta.description: 🧩️ One file line of a numstat commit block, after path unquoting and rename resolution.

path.description: 🧾️ The path the change lands on; for a rename this is the NEW path, already decoded from git's octal-escaped quoting.

rename_from.description: ↩️ The path the change came from, present only for a rename.

binary.description: 🧱️ A `-` / `-` row: git reports no line counts, so the change contributes nothing.

bucket.description: 🏷️ Absent when the path is skipped, binary, or classifies into no enabled bucket.

CommitDelta.description: 💿️ One parsed commit. A merge commit logged with `--first-parent` and no `-m` carries an empty `files` list and an empty `delta`, which is exactly how the parser must report it.

when_unix.description: ⏱️ Author timestamp in Unix seconds, UTC.

delta.description: 🧮️ Weighted per-bucket sums, which every aggregation reads instead of the file list.

GitTranscript.description: 🎞️ A recorded git session: exactly what the real CLI answered, so every metrics test is hermetic and every implementation replays the same bytes. Regenerated by `🏗️record-metrics-fixtures.ts` and re-verified against the live `git` binary by the `numstat-parsing` oracle.

logs.description: 📜️ `git log --numstat` stdout keyed by the ref it was recorded for; the empty key is HEAD.

tracked.description: 🧾️ Tracked repository-relative paths keyed by ref; the empty key is the working tree.

blobs.description: 📄️ File bodies keyed by `<ref>` U+0001 `<path>`; binary blobs are omitted, exactly as the scan skips them.

loc.description: 📏️ Unified LOC of the tracked tree in this bucket.

percent.description: 🧮️ Share of the `Total` row's LOC, rounded to two decimals; the `Total` row is exactly 100.

since_prev_loc_percent.description: 📉️ Percent change against the previous history row; absent on the first row. A `0 → n` step is defined as 100.

wip_percent.description: 🧮️ Share of the branch's whole edited-line churn, rounded to two decimals.

LocHistoryEntry.description: 💿️ One commit step of the history series. `languages` and `byContributors` are mutually exclusive.

date.description: ⏱️ RFC 3339 UTC rendering of the author timestamp.

LocReport.description: 💿️ The whole `loc` payload the CLI renders and the `loc` JSON format emits.

branch.description: ⛳️ The ref the history walk logged; empty when the run had no history.

TimeBucket.description: 🕰️ The granularity a commit stream is grouped at. `commit` keys by the RFC 3339 timestamp; `week` keys by ISO-8601 `YYYY-Www`.

TimeBucketGroup.description: 🕰️ One time bucket: its key, its first UTC second, the commits in it and their summed deltas. Groups are ordered by first appearance in the commit stream, which is oldest-first.

BenchmarkResult.description: 🔶️ One timing a benchmark process reported on a `name,time` stdout line.

BenchmarkRow.description: 📊️ One summary row: a case, its timing per ecosystem and the fastest ecosystem for it.

fastest.description: 🥇️ The ecosystem with the smallest parsed duration; ties break alphabetically. Absent when no timing parses.

BenchmarkSummary.description: 📊️ The whole benchmark table, which is also the row and column order of the CSV report.

languages.description: 🗣️ Fixed column order: Typescript, Python, Go, C#, Rust.
